articles.title: Technical SEO Audit Checklist for Modern B2B & SaaS Websites
articles.excerpt: A structured engineering guide to evaluating HTTP status codes, canonical alignment, SSRF-safe crawling, XML sitemaps, and JavaScript rendering for B2B websites.
articles.seoTitle: Technical SEO Audit Checklist for B2B & SaaS Websites | Mehula ADMediaTek
articles.seoDescription: Learn how to audit crawlability, canonical tags, structured data, and Core Web Vitals on modern B2B and SaaS websites without guesswork.
articles.featuredImageAlt: Diagram of HTTP crawl status, canonical tags, and structured data validation
toc: 3. Inspect Server HTML vs. Client-Rendered DOM

bodySections.heading: 1. Verify Indexability & Canonical Directives
paragraphs: Every indexable commercial page requires a deterministic, self-referencing canonical URL and an unambiguous 200 OK HTTP status code. When query parameters for tracking or sorting generate multiple URLs serving identical content, search engines split crawl equity unless canonical tags and parameter handling are explicitly configured.

Before evaluating keyword density or backlinks, inspect the raw HTTP response headers and <head> tags to confirm that x-robots-tag and meta robots directives are not inadvertently blocking priority pages.

bodySections.heading: 2. Audit XML Sitemaps & Robots.txt Governance
paragraphs: An XML sitemap should function as a curated manifest of canonical, 200-OK, indexable URLs—never a dump of every route in your router. Exclude authentication screens, private SaaS dashboards, internal API routes, draft articles, and non-canonical redirect URLs.
Remember that robots.txt controls crawling, not indexing or security authorization. Always protect administrative and CRM routes with server-side authentication and role-based access control.

bodySections.heading: 3. Inspect Server HTML vs. Client-Rendered DOM
paragraphs: Single-page applications and modern hybrid frameworks must ensure that titles, meta descriptions, canonical links, primary H1 headings, and core internal navigation links are consistently accessible and updated per route.

Avoid lazy-loading your primary above-the-fold Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) element, and always declare explicit width and height attributes or aspect-ratio containers to keep Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) below 0.1.

bodySections.heading: 4. Validate Schema.org JSON-LD Without Fabrication
paragraphs: Structured data helps search engines disambiguate Organization details, Services, BlogPostings, and BreadcrumbLists. However, injecting fake AggregateRating markup or unverified review counts violates search engine guidelines and risks manual actions.
Only populate JSON-LD fields that match visible, verified on-page content.

articles.title: How to Map Commercial Search Intent Across Multi-Service B2B Funnels
articles.excerpt: Why high search volume often produces low B2B conversion rates, and how to separate commercial solution queries from top-of-funnel research.
articles.seoTitle: Commercial Search Intent Mapping for B2B Funnels | Mehula ADMediaTek
articles.seoDescription: Structure your B2B service pages, industry verticals, and resource hubs to eliminate keyword cannibalization and capture qualified pipeline.
articles.featuredImageAlt: Matrix aligning search intent stages to dedicated service and industry landing pages
toc: 2. One Canonical URL Per Intent Cluster
3. Connecting Informational Guides to Service Pages

bodySections.heading: 1. The B2B Volume Trap
paragraphs: In B2B markets, broad head terms with tens of thousands of monthly searches are predominantly informational. Decision-makers evaluating an agency or enterprise software platform typically search with specific technical, industry, or regional modifiers.
Evaluating keywords solely by search volume leads teams to publish generic definitions rather than high-converting service and industry pages.

bodySections.heading: 2. One Canonical URL Per Intent Cluster
paragraphs: Keyword cannibalization happens when multiple service pages and blog articles target the exact same commercial query. Assign a single canonical URL to own each primary intent cluster, and use supporting articles to address narrow technical sub-questions.

bodySections.heading: 3. Connecting Informational Guides to Service Pages
paragraphs: Every educational article should include natural, descriptive internal links to the corresponding core service page and an interactive diagnostic option—such as an automated technical SEO audit—so interested readers have an immediate next step.

articles.title: Local SEO Architecture for Regional Enterprises in Ahmedabad & Gujarat
articles.excerpt: Practical standards for multi-branch citation hygiene, regional landing page differentiation, and LocalBusiness schema compliance.
articles.seoTitle: Local SEO Architecture for Regional B2B Enterprises | Mehula ADMediaTek
articles.seoDescription: Build durable regional search visibility across Ahmedabad and multi-city operations using verified entity signals and structured location pages.
articles.featuredImageAlt: Regional search visibility framework showing location pages and entity verification
toc: 2. Avoiding Doorway Page Penalties on City Pages

bodySections.heading: 1. Entity Consistency & Verified Location Data
paragraphs: Search engines cross-reference your organization name, address, telephone number, and primary category across your website footer, Contact page, LocalBusiness JSON-LD, and official business profiles.
Never publish placeholder addresses or unverified telephone numbers; wait until physical office details are confirmed so every citation matches 100%.

bodySections.heading: 2. Avoiding Doorway Page Penalties on City Pages
paragraphs: Swapping only the city name across twenty identical landing pages violates search engine doorway page policies. Only create dedicated regional or industry pages when you can provide genuinely distinct context, service scope, and local relevance.

bodySections.heading: 3. Measuring Calls and Consultation Requests
paragraphs: Tag regional profile links with structured UTM parameters so traffic and lead submissions from map listings are separated from standard organic search sessions in your analytics reports.

checks.explanation: Search engine crawlers require a clean 200 OK status on canonical landing pages.
HTTPS is a confirmed lightweight ranking signal and mandatory for user trust.
checks.recommendation: Keep TLS certificates active and enforce HSTS.

checks.explanation: Title tags define primary topical relevance and appear as the clickable headline in search results.
checks.recommendation: Write a unique, descriptive title between 30 and 60 characters.

checks.explanation: Well-written meta descriptions improve organic click-through rate (CTR) from search snippets.
checks.recommendation: Provide a unique 120–160 character summary with a clear value proposition.

checks.explanation: Each page should have one unmistakable primary H1 heading aligned with its core topic.
checks.recommendation: Add a descriptive primary H1 heading above the fold.

checks.explanation: Self-referencing canonical tags prevent duplicate content dilution from tracking parameters.
checks.recommendation: Add a self-referencing <link rel="canonical"> tag in the document <head>.

checks.explanation: A noindex directive blocks the page from appearing in search results.
Robots.txt and XML sitemaps guide crawler efficiency and indexation discovery.
checks.recommendation: Publish /robots.txt with an explicit Sitemap: declaration pointing to /sitemap.xml.

checks.explanation: Structured data helps search engines understand Organization, Service, and Breadcrumb entities.
checks.recommendation: Implement Organization, Service, or BlogPosting JSON-LD structured data.

checks.explanation: Internal links distribute page authority and descriptive alt text supports accessibility and image search.
checks.recommendation: Add contextual internal links to core services and ensure all informative images include alt attributes.

checks.explanation: Mobile viewport configuration, HTML language declaration, and fast server response times are core technical requirements.
checks.recommendation: Ensure <html lang="en"> and <meta name="viewport"> are declared in the document head.
